text: Pressed E on a chicken at tick ~771 with energy 82: toast says 'Harvested chicken meat.' but Inventory still shows Chicken Meat: 0; energy jumped to 99. Meat seems auto-eaten silently - the toast does not say it was eaten.

Inside Town of Cityfield at 960x540 (6/6 stalls): Market Info 'Merchants:' line wraps onto two lines ('Ruth Thompson, / Xavier Thomas +4') instead of fitting on one line as #350/#397 intend. Boxes do not overlap; Player Info reads 'Nation: Cityfield (LEADER)'.

Era (+) detail open inside town with 3 command rows (Order/Talk pawn rows present): era detail is a scroll region (scrollbar at x~193); wheel scrolls it to 'once every 2 minutes.' and the command bar stays uncovered. Works as #397 intends. Side effect: Inventory Info box moves to the centre (x 220-420, y 227-357) over the town plaza view.

Sell Resources with only 2 Chicken Meat (tick 3367): red toast 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 3 coins, and your cheapest good (chicken meat) sells for 31.' Message is clear and fits on two lines, but Market Info shows only the pooled '6/6 stalls, 6 coins' - the per-merchant purse that actually blocks the sale is never visible before clicking. And with a 6-stall market holding 6 coins total, food (worth 31+) cannot be sold at all early on.

After Purchase Food (bought 1 apple for 5 coins), Sell Resources sold the apple back for 5 - toast says only 'You sold resources to Frank Thompson. Relationship increased to 2.' with a '+5 coins' float; it does not say WHAT was sold (apple vs chicken meat) or the quantity. Chicken meat stays unsellable (24 coins vs richest merchant 6).

Inside town, the big world-space label 'Town of Cityfield / 7 here, 11/28 residents' sits at the top of the screen behind the status toast and the Chronicle box; its first line is cut off by the window top and the toast/chronicle draw over the second line, so the population count is hard to read.

Left column jumps: Inventory Info box top moves between y~227 and y~288 (rows1 vs rows3 screenshots) as pawn Order/Talk rows appear and disappear when townsfolk walk past; with era detail open it hops into the centre column. Distracting while reading.
First chicken: pt state listed 'Chicken 0.7m +90' at spawn (tick 143) but E gave 'No entities within range to interact with.' (see shots/chicken.png); after walkto (3.2 m) E worked.
